title.zh: Payy Halts Network After $1.92 Million USDC Drain
title.en: Payy Halts Network After $1.92 Million USDC Drain

current_state.zh: Payy paused its network, halting deposits, withdrawals and card payments, after roughly $1.92 million in USDC was drained and largely converted to about 683 ETH spread across three wallets.
